Purpose: Case-specific guidance only. These notes do not become live evidence unless current collection confirms them.
PriorityChecks: Correlate hard freezes with S4/Fast Startup or other resume transitions.
Capture current N92 BIOS version/date and current firmware-class PnP state.
Inspect Intel XTU or other low-level tuning components without assuming non-default tuning.
Measure disconnected-device and SetupAPI respecialisation evidence before attributing faults to the current physical machine.
Verify pagefile and crash-dump readiness before interpreting missing dumps.

KnownHistoricalBaseline: The reference case originally reported N92 BIOS 01.04 dated 2016-11-02.
The reference case had prior evidence of a failed-start HP N92 System Firmware capsule.
The delivered Windows image contained substantial non-present hardware history and Sysprep/respecialisation evidence.
Intel XTU components were present in the reference installation.
Two observed September freezes occurred shortly after S4/Fast Startup-style resume.
